mapping_json.fidelity_notes: CORPSE-FUEL BLAST: Detonate Dead explodes a corpse for a percentage of THAT CORPSE'S max life as fire AoE (dossier skill_loop: '6-7.9% of corpse max life'). Two lanes engage: (1) the corpse-as-ammunition ECONOMY has a NATIVE engine lane — charge_stack_sub_shape=accumulator with accumulator_fill_trigger=on-corpse-consume (verified engine enum, resource_economy.py:142); Desecrate refills the pool.
